notes: Peer-reviewed primary research article (BioResources 12(1)); record is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF. Measured sorbents: bamboo charcoal BC and KOH-activated carbons AC2-AC6 (Table 2: SBET and H2 uptake at 1 bar and 4 MPa, 77 K); AC5 is 90.11 wt.% C by EA (Table 1). Commercial Maxsorb-3 (3203 m2/g) is used as a comparison in Fig. 10 (PSD only). Table 3 also lists literature values from other papers, which are not this paper's measurements. No statement that the H2 uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. Internal inconsistencies for extraction: Table 2 heads the high-pressure column '4 MPa' while the text says capacities 'up to 8 MPa'; Fig. 9 caption assigns (a) to 'up to 8 MPa' and (b) to 'up to 1 bar', whereas the text says Fig. 9a shows the 1 bar isotherms. The paper calls the HPVA-100 a 'gravimetric analyzer'.
